title: Afterglow Studies
blurb: Design studies for the Afterglow film: one generated valley, drawn from code and lit by the hour. The poster and the series grow a new valley from a seed.

pages.title: Afterglow
pages.summary: The minutes after sunset, with the real stages of twilight on the side. Step through valleys with − and +.

pages.title: A day of light
pages.summary: Play or scrub 24 hours over the valley: sun, moon, stars and ten lighting moods.

pages.title: One valley, four hours
pages.summary: First light, noon, golden hour and blue hour. Nothing moves but the light.
